items.t: Engine stalls or dies while driving
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). Parts depend on the cause.

items.t: Misfires and stumbling from worn ignition parts
items.note: RepairPal estimates $238–329 for an ignition control module; plugs and wires cost less.

items.t: Cranks but won't start from failed distributor pickup
items.job: Replace ignition control module or distributor pickup
items.note: RepairPal estimates $238–329 for an ignition control module.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley bolt loosens or breaks
items.note: Shops quote about $250–450. More if the timing belt was damaged.

items.job: Replace head gasket, resurface head, new timing belt

items.t: Check engine light from loose or worn gas cap
items.note: Try tightening or replacing the cap before paying for diagnosis.

items.t: Water pump leaks at high mileage
items.note: RepairPal estimates $545–806. Do it with the timing belt to save labor.

items.t: Rough idle from leaking throttle body gasket
items.job: Vacuum leak diagnosis and throttle body gasket
items.note: Diagnosis (RepairPal: $122–179); the gasket itself is inexpensive.

items.t: Shift lever can slip out of Park (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
